page.overview:
Who is Hank Samson?

Hank Samson, the Farmhand, is a ficitonal character created by Fantasy Flight Games as a part of their Arkham Horror Files line of Cthulhu Mythos-related content.

Never the most cerebral of men, Hank has spent his whole life life working on the farm. When one day in the fields he spotted a colossal bird attacking the cattle, he didn’t think twice before picking up the nearest thing he could use as a weapon and killing it.

Since news got out about the incident, things have started to go bad for Hank: his Pa has disappeared, and word has reached him that a mysterious man is on his trail.

Arkham Horror states that Hank worked his whole life on the family farm, whilst Eldritch Horror has him as an itinerant worker.
